item.title: Selena Gomez Says She’s ‘Done Playing’ Alex Russo After ‘Wizards Beyond Waverly Place’ Finale: ‘This Is the End’
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome back to our show, where we dive into the latest trends and updates in the entertainment world. Today, we're talking about a blast from the past: the Wizards of Waverly Place franchise. The spin-off, Wizards Beyond Waverly Place, has just wrapped up with a four-part finale, and we're taking a look behind the scenes.
[Music transitions]
Host: Selena Gomez, who played Alex Russo, is reflecting on her journey with the franchise, which started back in 2007. In an interview with Entertainment Tonight, she shared her thoughts on saying goodbye to the character. "This is it. This is the end," she said. "It's really surreal to say that I'm done playing this character."
[Short clip of Selena Gomez's interview plays]
Host: Gomez also made her directorial debut on the third and final installment of the spin-off. And in a special treat for fans, Jennifer Stone, who played Harper Finkle, returned for the finale after being absent from the first two seasons. Stone shared her emotional experience of filming with Gomez, saying it felt like saying goodbye to her teenage self.
[Short clip of Jennifer Stone's interview plays]
Host: Selena Gomez has come a long way since her Wizards of Waverly Place days. She's now a successful pop star with 46 songs on the Billboard Hot 100, including the number one hit "Lose You to Love Me". And she's just dropped new music, including a collaboration with her husband Benny Blanco and Becky G.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in to our show. If you want to check out the Wizards Beyond Waverly Place finale, you can find it on Disney+. And don't forget to follow us for more updates on your favorite stars and shows.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
